Are you organised, proactive and great at keeping things running smoothly? Do you enjoy coordinating tasks, solving problems and putting your French language skills to use? Then you could be the perfect addition to our customer service team.

We are looking for an enthusiastic French-speaking Customer Supporter who thrives in a busy environment and enjoys a varied working day. Your main responsibilities will include:

• Processing orders and returns, and coordinating shipments to the French and Italian markets

• Keeping installers and dealers updated on important delivery information

• Handling enquiries from dealers, installers and agents by phone and email

• Supporting our external sales team

• Managing after-sales enquiries and cases

In this role, you'll be juggling multiple tasks and deadlines, often working across different departments. That's why we're looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys finding solutions and isn't afraid to reach out to colleagues when needed.

And don't worry – you won't be doing it alone! You'll be part of a supportive team that's always happy to help. Bring your curiosity, enthusiasm and willingness to learn, and we'll help you with the rest.

Do you fit this profile?

You're a natural problem-solver with a strong understanding of systems and processes, a service-minded approach and plenty of drive. Your educational background is not crucial, but your personal profile is. Therefore, it is a prerequisite that you:

• Speak and write fluent French (perhaps it's even your native language?)

• Have basic written and spoken English skills, as English is our corporate language

• Have experience of working with different systems (you may already be familiar with Microsoft CRM or BC365)

• Understands customers' needs and knows how to adapt their communication to different situations

It would also be a bonus if you:

• Have experience with EDI

• Speak and write Italian

Good to know

The position is full-time and requires on-site attendance, with working hours from 8-16 Monday to Thursday and 8-15.30 on Fridays.

Ready to join us?

Send your CV and a short, tailored application to HR@aduro.dk, with "Customer Supporter – French” in the subject line. Tell us why you are a good fit for the position and what motivates you to apply for the job.

We're looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, but we're happy to wait for the right person. Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, so don't wait too long to apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact our Customer Service Manager, Helle Kammer Riis, on +45 60 11 05 71.

About Aduro

At Aduro, we develop, manufacture and market wood-burning stoves, pellet stoves, hybrid stoves and bioethanol fireplaces, all combining innovative technology with modern Danish design. Today, we're proud to be among Europe's five largest wood-burning stove manufacturers, exporting 90% of our production.

Innovation is at the heart of what we do. Several of our products are patented, and we're constantly working to develop new solutions that push the boundaries of our industry.

Sollten wir Ihr neuer Arbeitsplatz sein?

At Aduro, you'll join a growing, dynamic company with a strong entrepreneurial spirit. We believe in sharing ideas, taking responsibility and helping each other succeed. Our working environment is informal and collaborative, with plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

We're proud of what we've achieved along the way. We've received the prestigious Gazelle Award seven times, recognising our strong growth. In 2024, we were also finalists for EY's Entrepreneur of the Year award and won the SME Inspiration Award in the Internationalisation category for our international outlook.

At our headquarters, you'll become part of an international team representing seven different nationalities. Different cultures and perspectives come together in an energetic workplace where ambition, teamwork and a good sense of humour go hand in hand. We offer modern facilities, social activities, a company lunch scheme and opportunities to develop your skills and take on new challenges.

Great code is only half the job

Cadpeople is hiring a frontend developer in Aarhus who writes solid code, understands the client, designs the system, and makes it feel right.

For 30 years, we've made the complex simple for companies like Vestas, Ørsted, Grundfos, Novo Nordisk and Fred. Olsen. We do it with 3D, XR, digital training simulators, virtual campuses, and digital learning, all built on our in-house frameworks.

The craft is changing too. AI tools already have a big impact on how we develop, and we're on a journey to strengthen our AI coding capabilities. But AI only pays off in the hands of developers with real knowledge and experience. That's why we look for systems thinking, client dialogue, and close collaboration with our creatives, as much as we do code.

What you'll do

You'll build bespoke applications for large enterprise clients, from the first workshop to the live solution. Typical work:

• Turn client needs into systems. Join client meetings and workshops, ask the right questions, and shape the solution before anyone writes code.

• Think across frameworks. Combine our in-house building blocks (Vue.js and Three.js frontends, Digital simulators, Umbraco headless CMS, .NET microservices on Azure, and Electron for offline use) into the right architecture for each case.

• Use what we've already built. Draw on experience from delivered projects to show the client what's possible, and to avoid building the same thing twice.

• Help shape how we build with AI. Use AI tools in your daily work, and help us strengthen our AI coding capabilities as we go.

• Work closely with creatives. Art directors, 3D artists, learning specialists, and project managers are your daily team. You make their ideas run in the browser, on a kiosk, or in a headset.

• Strengthen the foundation. Improve the frameworks on which every future project stands.

Who you are

We don't expect you to know it all. But you'll recognise yourself in most of this:

• You have at least 3 years of experience as a frontend developer, with solid JavaScript/TypeScript and Vue.js skills.

• You think in systems, not just screens: APIs, data, hosting, security and how it all fits together.

• You use AI coding tools fluently, and you still understand, review, and own every line that ships.

• You can explain technical choices to a client who isn't technical, in English. Danish is a plus.

• You care about how things look and feel, and you enjoy working with designers and 3D artists.

• You think big. A request for "an e-learning module" makes you wonder whether it should be a simulator, a virtual campus, or an AI coach.

• It's a plus if you know Three.js, WebGL, Umbraco, Node.js, .NET, Azure, CI/CD and security by design (OWASP Top 10).

Your education matters less than your curiosity and how well you work with others.

What you get

• Work that matters. Train wind turbine technicians, onboard energy workers, and help industrial companies explain products that change the world, often with a sustainability angle.

• Big clients, small team. Enterprise-scale projects with the speed and closeness of a 50-person agency in Aarhus and Edinburgh.

• A global parent with reach. Cadpeople is part of RelyOn, a global safety and training provider with more than 50 facilities worldwide. That gives us stability, new clients, and the chance to see your work train people in safety-critical jobs around the world.

• A head start on every project. Our own tested frameworks mean you start from a solid foundation, not a blank page.

• A say in what comes next. We're building up our AI coding capabilities, and this role can help shape how we get there.

• A creative workplace. An office in the heart of Aarhus, surrounded by people who make 3D, film, XR and learning. See our culture.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short application. A classic application is welcome, as long as it sounds like you. Generic AI-written applications will not be prioritised.

Want to stand out? You can add something small that shows your character and how you'd fit in at Cadpeople. It's optional, and it doesn't need to be big or complex. For example:

• A story about a time you turned a vague client need into something that worked.

• A short video, even filmed on your phone, about something you built or care about.

• A skill or tool, like a small AI agent, workflow or utility you made to work smarter.

• A thought on one of our cases: what you'd have done differently, or how you'd take it further.

Our office language is Danish, and we use English with many of our clients. You don't need to be fluent in Danish, but it helps if you understand it.

Questions about the role? Contact Nikolaj Have, CTO, at nikolaj.have@cadpeople.dk.

Start as soon as possible, or by agreement. All applications are treated confidentially, and submitted material is deleted after 6 months in line with GDPR.

**About The Company

**Founded in 2019, Novutech is a dynamic digital transformation partner with a team of over 60 consultants across Europe. We specialize in finance-focused digital transformation projects for international scale-ups and mid-sized enterprises. Our expertise lies in leveraging a core tech stack and the experience from hundreds of successful projects. We are committed to designing, delivering, and supporting end-to-end solutions that drive growth and efficiency.

**About The Role

**As a Senior Business Consultant, you will play a key role in delivering impactful digital transformation projects for our clients. Leveraging your NetSuite expertise, you will lead complex implementations, oversee advanced configurations, and act as a trusted advisor. You will also mentor junior consultants and progressively develop your people management skills, with the opportunity to lead your own team in the future.

• Lead and execute end-to-end NetSuite implementation projects, from requirements gathering to go-live and post-implementation support.

• Oversee advanced NetSuite configurations and customizations to meet customer needs, acting as a Subject Matter Expert.

• Configure, customize, and optimize NetSuite modules according to client needs.

• Monitor, test, validate, and resolve advanced problems in NetSuite areas.

• Maintain and document high-level processes and complex customizations for external stakeholders.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing best practices and recommendations.

• Support change management and user adoption initiatives.

• Manage overall relationships as Customer Success Manager for medium to large customers, handling tickets, organizing calls, and ensuring quality.

• Contribute to project planning, scoping, and estimation activities, collaborating with internal teams and stakeholders to ensure project success.

• Participate in sales and presales activities as an expert.

• Mentor and supervise business and tech analysts, providing guidance, feedback, and supporting their development through activities such as regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career growth planning, while ensuring high standards in methodology and consulting practices.

• Act as the right hand of the Manager or Director, upholding company values and amplifying leadership messages.

• Contribute to internal projects fostering innovation and growth through entrepreneurial ideas and OKRs.

• Stay updated on NetSuite developments and actively share knowledge with the team.

Why joining Novutech?

• Be part of a fast-growing company with a startup spirit, and enjoy a friendly environment with tremendous colleagues and a hybrid work setup.

• Experience a place where you can grow, learn, and make a significant impact.

• Benefit from a good work-life balance, fostering both personal and professional well-being.

• Enjoy international exposure by collaborating closely with colleagues across our global offices, enriching your professional experience and broadening your cultural understanding.

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in NetSuite consulting, implementation, or administration.

• Proven track record of successful NetSuite implementations and advanced configuration.

• Strong understanding of business processes (Finance, Accounting, Operations, etc.).

• Experience working in a consulting environment or with multiple clients.

• Demonstrated experience in mentoring, coaching, or supervising junior team members.

• Customer Success Management experience is a plus.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to build strong client relationships.

• Analytical and problem-solving mindset, with attention to detail.

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative, international team.

• Entrepreneurial spirit and drive for continuous improvement.

• Fluent in English; knowledge of French or Dutch is a plus.

• Willingness to travel occasionally within Europe as required.

If you are excited about the opportunity to make a difference and grow with us, we want to hear from you! Join Novutech and be part of an adventure that’s shaping the future of digital transformation.

**The Impact You'll Make

**Do you enjoy turning complex technical data into insights that drive better products and smarter decisions? Are you passionate about combining data science with engineering and domain expertise to solve real-world challenges? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

As our Lead Engineer, Data Science, you’ll play a key role in transforming product, sensor and operational data into meaningful insights that support innovation, energy efficiency and data-driven decision-making across Danfoss Climate Solutions.

Working closely with business teams, engineers and data platform specialists, you’ll combine strong analytical capabilities with engineering and domain knowledge to identify high-value opportunities, shape AI and analytics use cases and help build a robust, AI-ready data foundation for future intelligent solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Translate complex business and engineering challenges into analytical questions, data-driven models and actionable insights

• Analyze product, sensor, device and operational data to identify patterns, trends and opportunities for performance and energy optimization

• Apply engineering and domain knowledge to shape high-value data science and AI use cases, including feature definition, hypothesis development and validation strategies

• Collaborate with data engineers and platform teams to improve data quality, accessibility and usability across analytics and data products

• Contribute to semantic models and knowledge graph capabilities that capture relationships between sensors, devices, assets and their operational context

• Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to technical and business stakeholders, helping turn analytical findings into practical business actions

**What We're Looking For

**

• Strong foundation in thermodynamics and physics, with the ability to apply first-principles reasoning to heating and cooling systems and processes

• Experience in data science, applied analytics or similar roles within a technical, industrial or engineering environment

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in Python and SQL and the ability to translate engineering insight into data-driven models

• Good understanding of modern data and ML environments, including cloud platforms and the machine learning lifecycle

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, data and business teams

• Experience with HVAC, refrigeration, heating/cooling, energy systems or industrial operational data is considered a strong advantage

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

**

**

• Strong analytical capabilities and a solid understanding of financial planning, forecasting and performance management

• Advanced Excel skills and experience working with Power BI or similar reporting tools

• The ability to communicate complex information clearly and build strong relationships across functions

**About Demant

**Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health and innovation since 1904. The Group offers innovative technologies, solutions and expertise to help people hear better. From hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment, services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged across the hearing healthcare industry. Headquartered in Denmark, the Group employs more than 21,000 people globally and is present with solutions in 130 countries, where we create life-changing hearing health solutions as well as high-end audio and video solutions. The William Demant Foundation holds the majority of shares in Demant A/S, which is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and is among the 25 most traded stocks.

We are looking for a Senior Cyber Security Partner to join our team to support Enterprise IT .

Your impact begins here

As a Senior Cyber Security Partner, you will be the trusted security advisor for Enterprise IT. You will help ensure that cyber security is built into how your area works, makes decisions and develops.

You will translate current and emerging cyber risks into clear, practical advice, contribute to cyber security strategy, and build a strong partnership between your business area and central Cyber Security organisation. Your work will help protect the systems, technology, and data that Novo depends on to drive change for lasting health. Supporting Enterprise IT, you will work closely with your business area to understand its priorities, technology landscape and risk profile, adapting security guidance to its specific needs.

What you’ll bring

You combine broad cyber security expertise with a strong understanding of enterprise IT environments and the ability to build trust, connect security risk to business objectives, and move the business forward.

For the position supporting Enterprise IT, we are looking for experience advising on cyber security risks across enterprise applications and IT infrastructure, including cloud services, identity and access management, end user devices and networks.

This position requires the ability to translate cyber security risks into practical advice and support informed business decisions.

You will bring:

• 5–10 years of relevant experience within cyber security, information security, IT risk or related disciplines in a large or complex organisation.

• A strong understanding of IT and/or OT and the ability to connect security to business objectives.

• Experience with security frameworks such as NIST CSF or ISO 27001.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with your assigned area.

• Very good interpersonal, communication and coaching skills.

• The ability to collaborate and communicate with external parties such as vendors, consultants and authorities.

• A master’s or bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline.

• Full professional proficiency in English. Danish language skills may be an advantage but are not a requirement.

Useful, but not essential:

• Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM or CISA.

What you’ll do

You will be the go-to security partner for your assigned area: the person who translates threats and frameworks into practical advice that supports informed decisions and helps teams act on them with confidence.

• Act as the cyber security partner for Enterprise IT driving collaboration between your assigned business area and other security professionals.

• Provide expert advice on current and future security threats, translating risk into clear priorities your stakeholders can act on.

• Help stakeholders understand cyber risks, available options and appropriate mitigations, enabling informed, risk-based decisions.

• Support and contribute to cyber security strategies, making sure they reflect the realities and objectives of your assigned area.

• Promote and establish a strong relationship between your assigned area and Cyber Security, so security is considered early rather than added late.

• Work with external parties, including vendors, consultants and authorities, to keep security work moving forward.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Security Partners team within Cyber Risk and Resilience, working alongside eight colleagues serving as Security Partners and Business Information Security Officers (BISOs).

In your assigned area, you will provide trusted, risk-based cyber security leadership and help embed security into business and technology decisions.

Your closest partners may include:

• Data, process, business and contract owners

• IT system managers

• Managers, subject matter experts, architects and process teams

• Domain and enterprise architects

• Colleagues across Enterprise IT

• Cyber Security colleagues and other relevant specialist functions

Bringing these perspectives together, you will create clarity on security priorities, speak up when things stall and help teams make decisions they can own and follow through on. You will report to Erling Jepsen, Director.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to lead on security for areas that matter to how Novo works today and develops new treatments for tomorrow. Your expertise will be valued, your voice will be heard, and your advice will shape real decisions.

You will work with skilled security professionals, architects and partners across IT, OT and research, building your skills through practical, cross-functional experience. You will be supported to perform at your best, with honest feedback and clear expectations, in a team that combines curiosity, collaboration, and ambition.

Salary

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 to  1,245,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits

The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

If you are ready to become a trusted cyber security partner for Enterprise IT we would like to hear from you. Please indicate in your application if you have a particular interest in, or experience relevant to, either of the two areas.

Apply for the Senior Cyber Security Partner role by 30/10/2026.

For further information, please contact Erling Jepsen at (+45) 30759351.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Sr Business Operations Manager

Department: GMA Business Operations

Location: Søborg, Denmark

Your impact begins here

As Sr Business Operations Manager, you will help Global Medical Affairs (GMA) leadership make clearer, faster decisions on strategy, budget and priorities. You will advise senior leaders, lead complex projects where the problem is not yet defined, and co-own a key process that GMA teams rely on. Your work turns ambiguity into decisions, so medical affairs colleagues can focus their time and resources where they matter most for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

• Master’s degree in business, finance, sciences, engineering or a similar field.

• 5–7 years of relevant experience leading complex, cross-functional strategic projects and owning process improvement in a complex organisation.

• Experience leading financial planning and budget processes, challenging financial assumptions and aligning Finance and senior stakeholders around priorities and decisions.

• A proven ability to frame ambiguous problems, influence senior leaders, guide contributors and turn analysis into decisions.

• Excellent executive communication, strategic judgement and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence without authority and sustain alignment across senior stakeholder groups.

• Cultural awareness and adaptability, and a collaborative way of coaching colleagues.

What you’ll do

Your role combines three connected workstreams: partnering with GMA leaders, owning the budget process and leading projects. Together, they help GMA work with more clarity and speed.

• Advise the head of your assigned GMA area on the annual strategy process and its translation into budget priorities, framing trade-offs and challenging assumptions, dependencies and options.

• Co-own the budget process area with a team colleague, setting direction for templates, guidance and best practice, and leading adoption across GMA.

• Lead highly complex and ambiguous strategic projects: frame the problem, define scope and governance, set milestones and risk responses, and deliver on time, within budget and to the required quality.

• Strengthen governance by clarifying decisions, accountability and follow-up across interdependent work.

• Turn evidence into concise, data-driven recommendations, and prepare analyses, memos and presentations that shape GMA Leadership Team decisions.

• Share what you learn, improve common team methods and mentor colleagues, so the team stays resilient and consistent.

Who you’ll work with

You will join GMA Business Operations in Product & Portfolio Strategy, where colleagues connect commercial strategy, medical affairs and business development across therapy areas to help guide the Novo portfolio and strengthen competitiveness. You will report to the Director, GMA Business Operations, and work closely with your team colleagues to ensure success across the unit.

Your day-to-day partners include the GMA Leadership Team, leaders and specialists across GMA and medical affairs worldwide, Finance partner, and colleagues in Strategy, Executive Office and PMO functions. You will also have occasional contact with external parties.

The role is global in scope, with stakeholders across the world and minimal travel expected. Your influence comes from building trust, creating clarity and aligning functions whose priorities may differ.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to define your own approach to complex, unclear assignments, with minimal guidance and room to make your voice heard at senior level. You will grow by working across GMA and supporting functions, learning from colleagues and sharing your expertise through mentoring and strategic sparring.

We expect high standards and honest, direct conversations, and we support you to perform at your best.

Salary:  For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level,  location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring clarity to the decisions that shape Global Medical Affairs, apply for the Sr Business Operations Manager role by 9 November 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Location

Ballerup, Denmark

Job category

Digital & IT

Your impact begins here

As Software Asset Management (Lead/Senior), you will build Software Asset Management into an enterprise-wide capability that Novo governs and owns internally. You will connect entitle-ment, usage, contract and financial data so teams can make sharper investment decisions, ne-gotiate from evidence and simplify the technology landscape. Your work will turn software com-plexity into savings validated by Finance, lower risk and budget released for new priorities, giv-ing colleagues across Novo more room to focus on the work that matters.

What you’ll bring

You know enterprise software licensing well, from contract terms to deployment data, and you can turn that knowledge into decisions people trust. You will also bring:

· A relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience.

· Proven experience in building or maturing Software Asset Management or IT Asset Manage-ment governance and operating models in a complex organisation.

· Deep knowledge of complex software licensing, product-use rights, entitlement reconcilia-tion, effective licence positions, audit readiness and compliance risk.

· A solid understanding of SaaS, cloud marketplace, BYOL, AI and consumption-based com-mercial models.

· Experience with software sourcing, contract interpretation, vendor management and negoti-ations, supported by FinOps, cost transparency, forecasting and benefits tracking.

Hands-on experience with SAM and ITAM platforms such as Flexera One or similar, and an understanding of ServiceNow, CMDB, identity, discovery and endpoint-management tools.

· Strong data, analytics and reporting skills, with the ability to combine financial, contractual, technical and risk information into clear recommendations.

· The ability to influence without formal authority, guide people through new ways of working, and explain technical and contractual complexity in clear business terms to any audience.

· A pragmatic, accountable approach that keeps progress moving when information is incomplete.

Useful, but not essential:

· SAM, ITAM, FinOps, ITIL or vendor-specific certifications.

· Experience with application rationalisation and technology lifecycle management.

· Experience applying automation or governed AI to contract analysis, forecasting or decision support.

What you’ll do

You will set the direction and stay hands-on enough to speed up delivery. Success means clear accountabilities, repeatable cycles and value that Finance can confirm.

· Define and implement the SAM vision, mandate, governance, policies, controls and multi-year roadmap, with clear decision rights across technology, Procurement, Finance, Security and business owners.
